title: VibGUI: a graphical tool for automatic vibrational mode characterization  via  VEDA and VMARD
content: Interpreting experimental infrared spectra relies on assigning calculated normal vibrational modes to intuitive internal coordinates. However, existing tools have outdated user interfaces, or command-line complexity, leaving researchers without an accessible tool for automated vibrational mode characterization. To address this gap, we developed VibGUI, a Python-based graphical user interface that integrates two complementary methodologies for vibrational mode assignment: energy-based Potential Energy Distribution (PED) and statistical kinematic Vibrational Mode Automatic Relevance Determination (VMARD). Testing on diverse molecules in range from rigid aromatic ones to hydrogen-bonded ones showed that VibGUI accurately reproduces reference PED and VMARD results while completely eliminating manual redundancy reduction. VibGUI includes interactive 3D mode animations, simulated spectra, and percentage assignment tables of modes in HTML viewer, which allows easy IR spectra analysis for the broader chemical community.
